bez_zive_veze: No live connection — refreshing every 30 s
cfg_agent_notes_stribor: Voice and speech analysis — transcription, prosody, diarisation
cfg_agenti_uvod: Model per agent — “default” uses the tier from the registry. An override is stored in model-config.json → agentOverrides and takes effect immediately (no restart). local only = an Ollama model via API spawn — it works, but text only (no tools: Bash/files/MCP). Claude, Gemini, Kimi and OpenRouter models have FULL tools. REGOČ, Klaudio and Stribor are selectable here like the rest: Klaudio reads the override per message (no bot restart), while for REGOČ and Stribor it applies when they execute a task themselves. Message routing (which agent gets the job) does NOT go through this choice — it stays on the local Ollama classifier, which is changed in the „Classifier model" card below.
cfg_auth_ollama: A stock Ollama has no password — IP:port is enough (like RAG). A token only if it sits behind a reverse proxy.
cfg_auth_openrouter: Needs an API key (sk-or-...). Agents get FULL tools (bash/read/write) through the agentic tool loop. Billed per call.
cfg_fiksni_naslov: Permanent interface/main loop (e.g. Telegram service, orchestrator) — the model is not chosen here; the override does not apply.
cfg_int_opis_email: SMTP for notifications, IMAP for incoming messages. Sending needs the nodemailer library.
cfg_int_opis_github: Uses YOUR gh CLI and your own login (gh auth login). API mode needs an environment variable.
cfg_int_opis_gitlab: Uses YOUR glab CLI and your own login (glab auth login). API mode needs an environment variable.
cfg_int_opis_nextcloud: WebDAV: per-project folder and file upload. Use an app password, not your account password.
cfg_int_uvod: Connecting to YOUR services. Settings hold addresses and NAMES of environment variables — secrets live in a separate file with mode 0600, never in the JSON.
cfg_kartica_dezurni: Standby — fallback model when the primary one fails
cfg_kartica_klasifikator: Classifier model — message routing (separate from the executing model)
cfg_kartica_orkestrator: Orchestrator — the layer that starts agents on tasks
cfg_kartica_telegram: Telegram notifications — bot token + chat id (in package)
cfg_kartica_ulaz: Ingest gate — how a Telegram message enters the board
cfg_klas_izvor_naslov: Where the value actually comes from
cfg_klas_ollama_nedostupna: Ollama unreachable — the model list is incomplete

cfg_klas_svejedno_spremi: The setting can be saved anyway.
cfg_klas_uvod: REGOČ runs classification/routing on every message. This is NOT the same as the model an agent works with (that is the dropdown in the agent table above). The classifier must stay fast and local, so only Ollama models are offered. It is stored in {kljuc} (the credential store) and in componentOverrides.classifier; the config takes effect immediately, the environment only after the process restarts.

cfg_komp_knowledgeharvester: Knowledge extraction from sessions — 0 callers outside its own file and the tests

cfg_komp_modelrouter: AI model-agnostic routing — 4 providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama). Reachable: RegocDaemon.ts:22 → LocalOffload.ts:50
cfg_komp_moduleregistry: The class itself has 0 importers; TaskWebUI reads modules/module-config.json directly (lines 6601 and 9253), so the registry is not in service

cfg_komp_securitypipeline: 3 inspectors per tool call — 0 importers from code or hooks. The live L1 is ~/.claude/hooks/SecurityValidator.hook.ts (settings.json: PreToolUse + UserPromptSubmit), which does NOT use this module

cfg_ulaz_greska_citanja: Could not read the ingest gate
cfg_ulaz_nova_grupa_opis: A new group starts off — never on its own.
cfg_ulaz_opis_off: as today — the message goes straight to claude -p, the board is untouched
cfg_ulaz_opis_on: on — the message goes through the board: task → project → assignee → cost
cfg_ulaz_opis_shadow: shadow — the message goes as today, but what would be opened is logged
cfg_ulaz_prag_a: Threshold A — a task is opened
cfg_ulaz_prag_a_opis: Below the threshold (a greeting, a question) the answer goes out at once and the board stays clean. Default 16 (E2).
cfg_ulaz_prag_b_opis: Below the threshold a task gets a single assignee; above it goes research → plan → build → verify. Default 36 (E3).
cfg_ulaz_prag_c_opis: Above the threshold the plan is sent for approval and tasks are opened only once approved. Default 81 (E5).
cfg_ulaz_pragovi_rastu: The thresholds must increase: A ≤ B ≤ C.
cfg_ulaz_spremljeno: Saved — takes effect immediately, no restart
cfg_ulaz_ukljucena_opis: Off: every group works as today, regardless of the switch positions below.
cfg_ulaz_uvod: How a Telegram message enters the board — per group, three positions (off / shadow / on). The settings are stored in {putanja} and take effect immediately, without a restart — both the bridge and the board read the file on every pass. The manual brake (rule 17) still stops everything.

pauza_zaustavljeno_naslov: Work is stopped — click to resume
poredak_zadnji_rad_na_projektu_najnoviji: Order: last work on the project — newest first

pot_ishod_blocked_naslov: blocked_ok — the agent stopped at an obstacle on its own, not a failure
pot_ishod_failed_naslov: failed — spawn or result rejected, or the process died

chip_energija_naslov: electricity estimate from tokens (cost_log) — an estimate, not a measurement
